matching_rule: Case-insensitive exact plural word using Python regex \bgates\b. Singular gate, gating and gate IDs are not plural matches. Occurrence counts are whole-word matches, not substring counts.
project_count_warning: Project labels overlap: promptfix history line4054 is associated with both Tempo execution and a ViviVocab specification. Use union for combined counts.

deduplication.method: Original transcript message UUID plus session ID. A history event becomes an alias only when its same-session timestamp is within 100ms of the typed transcript event, with text/paste checked. Identical text in separate events is not globally deduplicated.

excluded_sdk_aggregation.reason: 241,167-character concatenation of implementation/status reports delivered through SDK; no independent human-input provenance. Excluded from user-input counts.

project_transcripts.search: rg -l -i gates (substring) over all *.jsonl recursively, then JSON parse and exact plural regex on user text only. Substring prefilter avoids serialized escaped-newline word-boundary errors. Original word-boundary prefilter yielded1,457 files;477 additional substring-only files were parsed and yielded no additional user-text matches. tool_result blocks and assistant/tool turns excluded.
